purpose: Evaluate the original Jon2 checkpoint on short Arabic user messages. This is an evaluation set, not training data.
scoring_note: Surface checks are not semantic approval. A human reviewer must judge whether each response matches the intent and conversation context.

cases.acceptance: Respond naturally to the greeting; do not demand a longer question.
Recognize a greeting and respond briefly.
Recognize thanks; do not answer an unrelated question.

history.content: الماء بيتجمد عند صفر درجة مئوية.

cases.acceptance: Explain the preceding statement; use context rather than inventing a new topic.
Continue the previous explanation without restarting or changing topic.
Treat this as confirmation and provide the offered example.
Respect the negative answer; do not provide the declined example.

history.content: أنا بسأل عن سعر الهاتف المذكور.

cases.acceptance: Understand this as a price follow-up; ask which item only if the item is not available in context.

history.content: موعد بدء الدورة لم يتحدد بعد.

cases.acceptance: Ask or answer about the timing of the event in context; do not fabricate a date.

history.content: المفتاح موجود في مكان ما بالبيت.

cases.acceptance: Ask for or clarify the location; do not invent one.
Ask one concise question about what help is needed.
Recognize agreement and proceed with the offered step.
